Task: General Text Translation

Write Python code that translates HTML or markup while preserving tags using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from google.cloud import translate

def translate_html_content(html_content: str, target_language: str) -> str:
    """Translates HTML content while preserving tags."""
    # Instantiates a client
    # Before running, make sure you've set up authentication for Google Cloud.
    # For example, by setting the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable.
    # See https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/getting-started
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()

    project_id = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT") # Or replace with your actual project ID
    if not project_id:
        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT environment variable not set.")

    location = "global"  # Or specify a region like "us-central1"
    parent = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}"

    # Supported mime_type: "text/plain", "text/html"
    # To preserve HTML tags, set mime_type to "text/html".
    response = client.translate_text(
        parent=parent,
        contents=[html_content],
        target_language_code=target_language,
        mime_type="text/html",
        model="projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/models/general/nmt" # Example model, general NMT is often implicitly used.
    )

    translated_text = response.translations[0].translated_text
    return translated_text
